title: Public policy routes respond successfully
description: Verify core public backend-rendered routes are reachable.

title: Unknown route returns non-success
description: Verify backend does not return success for a non-existent route.

steps.description: Verify HTTP status is non-2xx (404/301/302/4xx acceptable)

title: Admin entrypoint is gated
description: Verify unauthenticated /admin does not expose authenticated admin dashboard directly.

steps.description: Send GET request to /admin without authentication
Verify response is either redirect to /admin/login or login/unauthorized page content, not authenticated admin data

title: Domain API rejects anonymous caller
description: Verify session-protected domain API is not available anonymously.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/domains without authentication
Verify response is unauthorized/forbidden/redirect or explicit auth-required error

title: Shorten API validates empty payload
description: Verify /api/shorten does not accept empty payload.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/shorten with empty body
Verify response is validation/CSRF error and not success

title: Forgot password endpoint protected/validated
description: Verify forgot-password endpoint rejects bad unauthenticated post without required valid form context.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/forgot-password with invalid email payload
Verify response is non-2xx (validation or CSRF protection)

title: Security headers present on backend responses
description: Verify key security headers are returned by backend middleware in local HTTP mode.

title: Session cookie flags on login page
description: Verify backend sets session cookie attributes as configured.

steps.description: If Set-Cookie exists, verify HttpOnly and SameSite attributes are present
